Your partner asked to revert a ruling tagged `contradicts spec`. The skill says that kind of revert becomes a deferred item. It does not get implemented in this run. (Only an `(unclear)` ruling that gets overruled is implemented now, at protocol step 1.) So the branch stays at "3 or fewer" for now. The revert is recorded as a deferred item, and I'll say this plainly to your partner and offer to do it now if they want it on this branch. The other three rulings stand, and the night-email question is answered "no change," so neither produces work.

Order: plan markup → deferred items → history entry → retire the plan → delete the workspace.

**1. Plan markup** (append to the plan)

<edit path="specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md">
## Completion

Status: complete (2026-11-18). Branch `feat/dock-alerts`, commits 3f1a2b7..0b1c2d3. All four tasks were done and reviewed clean. The final whole-branch review was clean. Nothing was skipped.

Departures from this plan as written:
- Task 2: the threshold shipped as "3 or fewer free slots," not "2 or fewer" (contradicts spec § 2). The partner has asked for it to be reverted to 2 or fewer. That revert is deferred; see `specs/deferred_items.md`.
- Task 3: the module is `alerts/notify.py`, not `alerts/send.py`, because `send` shadows the socket helper the service already imports. The function is still `send_alert(dock_id: str) -> None`.
- Task 3: the reviewer asked to batch alerts into one email. Declined: the plan sends one email per alert (spec § 3).
- Final review: the retry-jitter finding was left out on purpose, because the tests seed the jitter.
- Final review, Declined to judge: whether email is the right channel for alerts at night. The partner ruled that email is fine and no change is needed.
</edit>

**2. Deferred item**

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
## Revert dock-alert threshold to 2 or fewer free slots (from plan 12-dock-alerts)

- Origin: Task 2 ruling in plan 12. The threshold shipped as "3 or fewer free slots" because docks refill more slowly than the design assumed.
- Partner decision (2026-11-18): revert to "2 or fewer," as spec § 2 says.
- Work: change the threshold in the alert check back to `<= 2` and update the Task 2 tests that assert the 3-slot boundary.
- Cost while open: the operations team gets about one extra alert a day.
- Done when: the code matches spec § 2, and the `specs/history.md` entry for plan 12 is updated to say the ruling was reverted.
</edit>

**3. History entry** (this records the tagged ruling in place of a spec amendment, so the spec text is left as-is)

<edit path="specs/history.md">
## 2026-11-18 — plan 12-dock-alerts (`specs/dock-alerts.md`) complete

- Departs from § 2 Alert threshold: the code alerts at 3 or fewer free slots, not 2 or fewer. The spec is not amended. The partner wants this reverted to the spec value, and that revert is pending as a deferred item ("Revert dock-alert threshold to 2 or fewer free slots").
- § 3 Alert channel confirmed: one email per alert. Batching was declined, and email is confirmed as fine for alerts at night.
- Alert module lives at `alerts/notify.py`.
</edit>

**4. Retire the plan and commit**

<command>
mkdir -p specs/plans/completed && git mv specs/plans/12-dock-alerts.md specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md
</command>

<command>
git add specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md specs/deferred_items.md specs/history.md && git commit -m "Complete plan 12-dock-alerts; defer threshold revert to spec § 2"
</command>

**5. Delete this plan's workspace.** The protocol has finished and there were no final-review fixes to merge. I delete only this plan's directory. Other plans' directories and `.sdd` itself stay.

<command>
rm -rf .sdd/12-dock-alerts
</command>

**Message to my partner:**

> Plan 12 (dock alerts) is complete and retired to `specs/plans/completed/12-dock-alerts.md`, and its workspace is deleted.
>
> One thing to know: **the threshold is not reverted yet.** The branch still alerts at 3 or fewer free slots. Our process turns a revert of a ruling that was already taken into a deferred item rather than new work in this run. It's in `specs/deferred_items.md` as "Revert dock-alert threshold to 2 or fewer free slots," and `specs/history.md` notes that the code departs from § 2 until that's done. The cost while it's open is about one extra alert a day.
>
> If you'd rather not merge `feat/dock-alerts` with the spec mismatch, say so. I'll make the change on this branch now: one comparison and the boundary tests. Then I'll close the deferred item.
>
> As you ruled, the other three rulings stand (`alerts/notify.py`, one email per alert, the seeded jitter), and email at night needs no change.
